name: decimal-totals-and-single-email-per-file
description: One email per polled file, containing every row. totalPrice = units * pricePerUnit as a number: integral results print without decimals (10 * 0.1 -> 1), others keep their decimals (1.5 * 2.5 -> 3.75); name and orderId stay strings.

source.reference: sending-a-csv-file-through-email-using-smtp/src/main/app/csv-to-smtp.xml dw:transform-message 'Transform CSV to Map' (as :number) and smtp:outbound-endpoint; number rendering as in src/main/resources/email.txt (2.0 -> 2, 2.0*10 -> 20)

expected.body: [{name=ccc, orderId=3, pricePerUnit=2.5, units=1.5, totalPrice=3.75}, {name=ddd, orderId=4, pricePerUnit=0.1, units=10, totalPrice=1}, {name=eee, orderId=5, pricePerUnit=4, units=3, totalPrice=12}]
